videos.notes: Recorded and verified on OncoBrief release candidate baseline.
videos.originalProblem: normalizeLanguageCode() coerced all locales to en-IN due to case-sensitivity bug; Odia provider code was mismatched; multi-chunk WAV concatenations corrupted RIFF headers.
videos.implementationChanges: Canonicalized normalizeLanguageCode() with case/underscore tolerance; mapped Odia or-IN to Sarvam od-IN; built parseWavBuffer() & mergeWavBase64Chunks() with accurate 44-byte RIFF headers.
videos.demonstratedBehavior: 11-locale language selector active; Hindi (hi-IN) and Tamil (ta-IN) selection; assistant launcher voice panel; automated contract test execution with 15/15 pass.
videos.historicalComparisonNotes: Preserved Phase 01A baseline and contract tests accurately document the corrupted WAV header vs reconstructed 44-byte RIFF header.

videos.notes: Recorded and verified on OncoBrief release candidate baseline.
videos.originalProblem: Continuity messages lacked native-script rendering; allowed literal variables lacked appointment_date; ungrounded OPD slot offers failed checkMessageGate() with HTTP 409.
videos.implementationChanges: Added appointment_date to ALLOWED_LITERAL_VARIABLES; implemented resolveLocalizedMessageText() rendering verified variables into native Indic scripts; grounded OPD slot variables.
videos.demonstratedBehavior: Consented caregiver network; draft vs approved message gating; Tamil-script preview resolution; ContinuityAudioPlayer playback; literal variable grounding.
videos.historicalComparisonNotes: Documented earlier HTTP 409 gate failure on ungrounded messages vs zero-blocker approval in Phase 01B.

videos.notes: Recorded and verified on OncoBrief release candidate baseline.
videos.originalProblem: Fabricated raw-byte ASCII scraping on corrupt buffers; fake 4-second setTimeout delays in UI; missing language selector in upload form; lack of two-stage clinical span validation.
videos.implementationChanges: Restored Sarvam Vision OCR adapter (10/10 tests); added language selector to DocumentUploadForm; eliminated fake delays; enforced two-stage span validation for all 9 FactValue variants.
videos.demonstratedBehavior: Synthetic report intake; language-aware OCR routing; honest telemetry without fake delays; Evidence Ledger extraction; mathematical [0, 1] bounding box highlight; human fact verification.
videos.historicalComparisonNotes: Preserved test suites demonstrate rejection of corrupt buffers without ASCII scraping, and rejection of candidate facts with unentailed values.

videos.notes: Demonstrates synthetic FHIR R4 bundle import, JSONPath element pointers, authorized mCODE export, ABDM HIP/HIU workflows, and consent revocation.
videos.originalProblem: Lack of bidirectional FHIR R4 interoperability; missing NRCeS and HL7 mCODE oncology mappings; unhardened FHIR HTTP client.
videos.implementationChanges: Built bidirectional FHIR importer/exporter; enforced JSONPath element pointers for FHIR provenance; implemented ABDM HIP M2 and HIU M3 flows; hardened SSRF defenses.
videos.demonstratedBehavior: Synthetic FHIR R4 DiagnosticReport ingestion, JSONPath element pointers in Evidence Ledger, authorized mCODE export, ABDM consent gating, and interop test suite execution.
videos.historicalComparisonNotes: Carefully distinguishes simulated/synthetic sandbox testing from external live ABDM production gateway.

videos.notes: Demonstrates production app launch, clinical boundary scans, PostgreSQL RLS non-superuser security, SSRF defenses, natural chart interactions, and release blockers.
videos.originalProblem: Discrepancy in RLS tenant session variables (app.org_id vs app.current_tenant_id); advanced SSRF bypasses in FHIR client; { force: true } clicks in Playwright chart tests.
videos.implementationChanges: Set both app.org_id and app.current_tenant_id in client.ts; added 10 RLS tests under non-superuser oncobrief_app; blocked hex/octal/IPv6-mapped SSRF; eliminated all { force: true } overrides.
videos.demonstratedBehavior: Production app launch, natural pointer hover/click on SVG oncology chart, clinical boundary scan, PostgreSQL RLS security tests, SSRF mitigations, and release blocker accounting.
videos.historicalComparisonNotes: Independent audit confirmed local staging pass with zero regressions and transparent external prerequisite tracking.
